college_computer_science: Answer questions about computer science at an undergraduate level, including but not limited to algorithms, data structures, computer architecture, operating systems, and programming language theory.
anatomy: Answer questions about human anatomy, including but not limited to the structure, organisation, and physical features of body systems, organs, and tissues. Focused on normal structure rather than disease or treatment.
college_chemistry: Answer questions about chemistry at an undergraduate level, including but not limited to chemical reactions, molecular structure, thermodynamics, and laboratory techniques. Focused on chemical processes rather than living organisms.
clinical_knowledge: Answer questions about clinical medicine and patient care, including but not limited to diagnosis, treatment, symptoms, and medical practice guidelines. Focused on disease and treatment rather than normal anatomical structure.
college_biology: Answer questions about biology at an undergraduate level, including but not limited to cell biology, genetics, evolution, and physiology. Focused on living organisms and biological processes rather than pure chemical reactions.
abstract_algebra: Answer questions about abstract algebra, including but not limited to groups, rings, fields, and other algebraic structures and their properties.
business_ethics: Answer questions about ethical principles and dilemmas in business, including but not limited to corporate responsibility, decision-making, and professional conduct.
astronomy: Answer questions about astronomy, including but not limited to celestial objects, the solar system, stars, galaxies, and the physical processes of the universe.
